title: SEC EDGAR Filings & XBRL Financials Input

tickersOrCiks.title: Stock Tickers or CIKs
tickersOrCiks.description: US stock tickers (e.g. 'AAPL', 'NVDA', 'MSFT') or SEC CIK numbers (e.g. '0000320193'). Leave empty only when searching by companyName.

companyName.title: Optional Company Name Search
companyName.description: Search SEC EDGAR registered entities by company name when ticker or CIK is unknown (e.g. 'Berkshire Hathaway', 'Eli Lilly').

forms.title: SEC Form Types (or ['ALL'])
forms.description: SEC filing form types to extract (e.g. ['10-K', '10-Q', '8-K', '4', 'DEF 14A', 'S-1']) or ['ALL'].

filingDateFrom.title: Minimum Filing Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
filingDateFrom.description: Optional earliest SEC filing date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-01-01').

includeFinancialSnapshot.title: Include Audited 10-K XBRL Financial Snapshot
includeFinancialSnapshot.description: Fetch official US-GAAP XBRL CompanyFacts to attach latest Revenue, Net Income, Profit Margin %, Total Assets, Equity, and Cash.

maxFilingsPerCompany.title: Max Filings per Company
maxFilingsPerCompany.description: Maximum number of matching SEC filings to return per company (1–100).

outputMode.title: Output Mode
outputMode.description: Choose between detailed filing dataset rows or a compact MCP financial intelligence summary.
